entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I don't have time for a thousand questions! It doesn't track my heart rate right, the GPS is slow, I just don't want it. I'm looking at your website right now and it says I can return it.

I understand your frustration, sir. I see here that you received the item 27 days ago. Unfortunately, for a wearable device, it is now too late to process a return. Our updated return policy has a very strict window because of hygiene and sanitation concerns with products that have skin contact.

Are you kidding me?! That is absolute garbage! Your website says 10 days! NINETY! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is a scam and I'm going to blast VeloFit on every review site on the internet!
I apologize for the miscommunication, sir. Let me put you on a brief hold while I pull up our official internal knowledge base. There may be different terms for your specific model. Please hold.

Thank you for your patience. Sir, you are absolutely correct and I sincerely apologize. I was referencing a new guideline that hasn't taken effect yet. Our active, official policy, as you stated, is indeed 10 days. You are unfortunately outside that window.
Well, finally. It's about time. You people need to get your story straight. So are you going to process this or not?
Yes, of course. I can process this return for you immediately. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to the email address we have on file. Is that still correct?
Yes, that's the right one. Send it over.
The label has been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Just make sure it goes through.
It will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
